messages:
carmen: Opening a tiny focused PR to refresh the HelloBridge quickstart: simplify auth text, add a one-file Docker example, and fix a couple of SDK snippet mismatches between JS and Python. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4470. Need quick review on the auth fallback and Docker ownership note.

lee: Quick skim looks good. Two things: 1) call out the env var fallback (`REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY:-$REDWOOD_TOKEN}`) in the README so CI and local dev both pass; 2) shorten the JS snippet so it's fully copy-pasteable.

oscar: I'll tidy the JS snippet. Also add a 1-line note that frontends must proxy requests and never embed keys. Maybe a small code comment in the snippet.

docs-bot: link-checker: flagged broken link -> /sdk/v2/auth (404). Suggested replacement: /sdk/latest/auth. Added PR comment.

carmen: Thanks. I'll update the link and add the env fallback. For the Dockerfile, I'll ensure we create /root/.redwood and set permissions: `RUN mkdir -p /root/.redwood && chown 1000:1000 /root/.redwood`.

ci-bot: CI: smoke run queued for PR #4470. Current: lint -> passing, unit -> passing, e2e -> pending. Will report final status.

lee: When CI is green I'll do a final copy edit and merge. If anyone sees a wording that over-indexes on infra, call it out.

carmen: Merging plan: push edits tonight, wait for CI, aim to merge tomorrow morning. Ping @lee for merge approval. Thanks!
